summary: Repair the rejected-provider mutation APIs without discarding stored sibling accounts.

patterns: Use the existing strict auth-store decoder and locked mutation access.
constraints: Keep both public mutation signatures and their false or undefined no-change results.
Preserve every original file byte when the provider has a partially damaged account collection or a healthy valid entry.
Continue replacing wholly rejected provider entries while preserving unknown sibling values.
A successful receipt must retain the exact before and after entries.
Change only src/infra/auth/auth-store-mutations.ts. Do not change tests, dependencies, or the runtime.

milestones.goal: Distinguish a wholly rejected provider entry from a damaged account collection in both mutation APIs.

tasks.description: Repair replaceRejectedProviderCredentials and replaceRejectedProviderCredentialsWithReceipt so partially damaged collections remain untouched, wholly rejected entries still repair, healthy entries stay unchanged, and successful receipts retain exact entries.
test_scenarios: Both APIs preserve all bytes and return no change for a collection with a healthy account and a damaged account.
Both APIs replace a wholly rejected metered provider and preserve an unknown sibling; the receipt contains the exact original and written entry.
Both APIs preserve all bytes and return no change for a healthy subscription provider.

milestones.qualitative_verification: Inspect both locked mutation decisions and confirm that neither damaged collections nor healthy entries can reach a write.

success_criteria: Both mutation APIs preserve damaged account collections and healthy providers without rewriting the file.
Wholly rejected entries still repair without changing unknown sibling values.
Successful receipts retain the exact before and after provider entries.
